# Mit Sheth — Portfolio Website

Dota 2-themed developer portfolio for Mit Sheth (Software Engineer, iOS & Swift).

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 16 + TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS 4
- GSAP (animations)

## Commands

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED from package.json scripts -->
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `npm run dev` | Start development server at localhost:3000 |
| `npm run build` | Production build with type checking |
| `npm run start` | Run production build locally |
| `npm run lint` | Run ESLint |
<!-- END AUTO-GENERATED -->

## Deployment

- **GitHub:** github.com/mit112/portfolio-website
- **Live:** portfolio-website-five-red-11.vercel.app
- Auto-deploys on push to `main` via Vercel

## Assets

Real Dota 2 game assets sourced from `dotabase.dillerm.io`.
URL pattern: `dotabase.dillerm.io/vpk/panorama/images/{category}/{filename}.png`
